_comment: One public page per CBAT test at /cbat-tests/<slug>, generated at build time by scripts/build-cbat-test-pages.mjs from the guide's TESTS array (public/cbat-guide.html). guideId must match a TESTS id. gameKeys are the CBAT_GAMES boards whose runs feed the page's public stats (ranked boards only, never practise/tutorial keys). playPath is the game route the page links to. Shared by the backend (public-stats endpoint) and the frontend (intro-card link), like categories.json.

tests.title: CBAT FLAG Test: What It Is Like and How to Practise
tests.description: What the CBAT FLAG test (Figures, Logistics and Groups) is really like, what candidates say about it, and how to practise the multitasking for free.

tests.title: CBAT ANT: Airborne Numerical Test Tips and Practice
tests.description: What the Airborne Numerical Test (ANT) is really like: speed, distance, time and fuel questions, the traps candidates report, and free practice.
